verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for docs.orama.com/llms.txt, which serves a structured index of the docs, including the Cloud and MCP Server pages. The docs also publish an llms-full.txt that bundles full content such as projects, data sources and Cloud details, so an agent can be pointed at either file. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/llms-full.txt offering, and independent corroboration of how complete it is for agents.
